limitations: Proposed research screen, not admission. Separately verified publisher English labels remain required. Short, code-heavy and uncertain detector results become explicit review attention rather than hard English rejection; only confident non-English prose windows with at least 80 alphabetic characters trigger the new hard language flag. Twelve natural negatives, sixteen explicit controls and 77 previously read paths are selected development diagnostics, not probability calibration or source-wide error bounds. Existing privacy/scope/text-integrity/code/identity/template and whole-group review exclusions remain. Unsampled errors and sensitive material may remain; independent population review and a bound admission decision are still required.
scope: Measure a proposed local language-foundation research pool. Not a release or conversation-SFT gold corpus.
